summary.text: Gus Gustafson is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 55 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his current term as beginning on January 3, 2023.

paragraphs.text: Nate Gustafson, who goes by Gus, was born in Appleton, Wisconsin, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned an associate degree from Fox Valley Technical College in 2018, and his career experience includes working as an Epic analyst at NOVO Health Technology Group.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, his biography said he has lived his entire life in the Village of Fox Crossing and attended the Neenah Joint School District.

Gustafson was assigned to the Science, Technology, and AI Committee as chair, the State and Federal Relations Committee as vice-chair, the Government Accountability and Oversight, Judiciary, Regulatory Licensing Reform and Ways and Means committees, and the Information Policy and Technology Committee as co-chair for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
